title: PB-DBP-like cascade of small triplet stages in our coordinates
question: Does a cascade of small triplet stages beat the one-step triplets (M31, K2048, M51) at equal RM on our data?
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation

value_filter.changes_next_step: yes: positive opens E041 (mixed stages need a working cascade); negative means multi-step is not needed for single-polarization data with linear effects removed, E041 only after the author's decision
value_filter.answered_in_literature: partly: PB-DBP (Redyuk et al., Optics Continuum 4(12) 2896, 2025) shows the cascade for their data; not for ours
value_filter.needed_for_main_claim: yes: the main claim is 'one-step triplets lead above ~4k RM'; a cascade is the natural stronger rival
value_filter.cheaper_without_training: no: the cascade has no closed form

decision_if_positive: cascade becomes the reference triplet family in E043; run E041 against it
decision_if_negative: one-step closed-form triplets stay the reference; write that multi-step is not needed here; E041 only after the author's decision (results/gate_e040.json)
model: cascade_e040.Cascade, stages of type T: x_s = FIR_s(x_{s-1} + T_s(x_{s-1})); C_mn = C_nm = C_{-m,-n} = -C*_{-m,n}, |m|,|n| <= M, |mn| <= K_th; C = 0 and FIR = unit impulse at start; end to end, Adam, MSE

grid.filter_note: RM (repository convention) within 1 000 - 30 000 and receptive field <= 301 symbols (cost per step grows with it); every n_stages > 1 point also with shared C

lr_note: one fixed lr (cosine_to_zero 1e-3, the E035 choice for triplets by gradient); the one-step references are closed form (no tuning)

confirm.rule: per level, the 2 best grid points by mean validation with RM within +-5 % (and their shared / independent twin)

references.one_step: E031 / E034 / E036 summaries: the best by validation with RM <= 1.05 x level (closed form, 5 bootstrap replicas)

rm_conventions: every point also with the two E039 conventions (cascade_e040.rm_variants)

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.cascade_better: the cascade beats the one-step triplets at RM level K (6k, 12k, 18k; RM within +-5 %) if its test BER reduction is higher by >= max(1.5 p.p., 2 x the seed spread of this experiment's control) and the min-max intervals over seeds do not overlap, on at least 2 of 3 levels; otherwise not distinguishable
rule_draft.shared: reported: shared minus independent C at the same configuration (5 seeds, confirm)

level_matched.note: the planned grid has no point within +-5 % of 6k, 12k, 18k RM; added before the run: for every (n_stages, M, L) the integer K_th (1 .. M^2) whose RM is closest to the level, if within +-5 % and the receptive field <= 301 (with its shared twin)
